1.

Behold, the glory shines Down on my path of pilgrimage, It speaks of His love, Who gave Himself for me. Though here in a wilderness A little time I walk, The Lord Jesus strengthens me With grace that all avails.

2.

Behold, the door of heaven stands open, I see my Father’s home, And the journey grows shorter, I have not far again. I travel to the good land, Which already in faith I have reached, To behold Him who with me Has gone the whole way.

3.

His sweet voice calls me To come where He is; My soul hastens toward the goal, I will not rest here. My spirit’s wings lift themselves, My homeland I shall soon reach, And the glory shines From the Father’s house brightly.
